title: Option to display apps as icons only
line: Quicklaunch has a new "Show launcher names in popup" option; turning it off shows the popup as a compact row of icons.
explanation: The Quicklaunch popup (the launchers behind the expander arrow) always showed each launcher as icon plus name in a 20-gridunit-wide vertical list, so next to a vertical panel it took far more room than the icons need. The existing "Show launcher names" option only affects the launchers on the panel itself. The change adds a "Show launcher names in popup" option (on by default, so nothing changes for existing setups); when it is off the popup hides the labels and lays the launchers out as a single horizontal row of square icon cells, with the name and description still shown in each launcher's tooltip.

commits.message:
applets/quicklaunch: add option to show the popup as icons only

The popup always listed launchers with their names, which takes a lot
of room next to a vertical panel. A new option hides the names and lays
the popup out as a single row of icons, with names still in tooltips.

BUG: 498273

patches.diff:
From c136a80a86152ed7c804ba69fb3681f492f7a02b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 18:53:11 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/quicklaunch: add option to show the popup as icons
 only

The popup always listed launchers with their names, which takes a lot
of room next to a vertical panel. A new option hides the names and lays
the popup out as a single row of icons, with names still in tooltips.

BUG: 498273
---
 applets/quicklaunch/ConfigGeneral.qml | 7 +++++++
 applets/quicklaunch/IconItem.qml      | 2 +-
 applets/quicklaunch/Popup.qml         | 5 +++--
 applets/quicklaunch/layout.js         | 3 +++
 applets/quicklaunch/main.qml          | 1 +
 applets/quicklaunch/main.xml          | 3 +++
 6 files changed, 18 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/quicklaunch/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/quicklaunch/ConfigGeneral.qml
index 11b6b38a9..9ceeb3926 100644
--- a/applets/quicklaunch/ConfigGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/quicklaunch/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
     property alias cfg_maxSectionCount: maxSectionCount.value
     property alias cfg_showLauncherNames: showLauncherNames.checked
     property alias cfg_enablePopup: enablePopup.checked
+    property alias cfg_showPopupLauncherNames: showPopupLauncherNames.checked
     property alias cfg_title: title.text
 
     Kirigami.FormLayout {
@@ -49,6 +50,12 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             text: i18nc("@option:check", "Enable popup")
         }
 
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: showPopupLauncherNames
+            enabled: enablePopup.checked
+            text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show launcher names in popup")
+        }
+
 
         Item {
             Kirigami.FormData.isSection: true
diff --git a/applets/quicklaunch/IconItem.qml b/applets/quicklaunch/IconItem.qml
index ab6d8aba3..594b95dc6 100644
--- a/applets/quicklaunch/IconItem.qml
+++ b/applets/quicklaunch/IconItem.qml
@@ -353,7 +353,7 @@ Item {
             PropertyChanges {
                 label.horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignLeft
                 label.verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
-                label.visible: true
+                label.visible: showPopupLauncherNames
                 label.elide: Text.ElideRight
                 label.anchors.leftMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
                 label.anchors.rightMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
diff --git a/applets/quicklaunch/Popup.qml b/applets/quicklaunch/Popup.qml
index 2224a29b8..e76d9803f 100644
--- a/applets/quicklaunch/Popup.qml
+++ b/applets/quicklaunch/Popup.qml
@@ -27,8 +27,8 @@ Item {
     required property Logic logic
     required property UrlModel launcherModel
 
-    width: LayoutManager.popupItemWidth()
-    height: Math.max(1, popupModel.count) * LayoutManager.popupItemHeight()
+    width: (showPopupLauncherNames ? 1 : Math.max(1, popupModel.count)) * LayoutManager.popupItemWidth()
+    height: (showPopupLauncherNames ? Math.max(1, popupModel.count) : 1) * LayoutManager.popupItemHeight()
 
     DragAndDrop.DropArea {
         anchors.fill: parent
@@ -110,6 +110,7 @@ Item {
 
         focus: true
         interactive: true
+        orientation: showPopupLauncherNames ? ListView.Vertical : ListView.Horizontal
         keyNavigationWraps: true
 
         model: UrlModel {
diff --git a/applets/quicklaunch/layout.js b/applets/quicklaunch/layout.js
index b4fe49ed0..0a7f45a11 100644
--- a/applets/quicklaunch/layout.js
+++ b/applets/quicklaunch/layout.js
@@ -102,6 +102,9 @@ function preferredCellHeight()
 
 function popupItemWidth()
 {
+  if (!showPopupLauncherNames) {
+    return popupItemHeight();
+  }
   return Math.max(root.width, Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium + 20 * Kirigami.Units.gridUnit);
 }
 
diff --git a/applets/quicklaunch/main.qml b/applets/quicklaunch/main.qml
index 012b52556..332d1c2f0 100644
--- a/applets/quicklaunch/main.qml
+++ b/applets/quicklaunch/main.qml
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     readonly property int maxSectionCount: Plasmoid.configuration.maxSectionCount
     readonly property bool showLauncherNames : Plasmoid.configuration.showLauncherNames
     readonly property bool enablePopup : Plasmoid.configuration.enablePopup
+    readonly property bool showPopupLauncherNames : Plasmoid.configuration.showPopupLauncherNames
     readonly property string title : Plasmoid.formFactor == PlasmaCore.Types.Planar ? Plasmoid.configuration.title : ""
     readonly property bool vertical : Plasmoid.formFactor == PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical || (Plasmoid.formFactor == PlasmaCore.Types.Planar && height > width)
     readonly property bool horizontal : Plasmoid.formFactor == PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal
diff --git a/applets/quicklaunch/main.xml b/applets/quicklaunch/main.xml
index 71528c90e..ea2492d1b 100644
--- a/applets/quicklaunch/main.xml
+++ b/applets/quicklaunch/main.xml
@@ -15,6 +15,9 @@
     <entry name="enablePopup" type="Bool">
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="showPopupLauncherNames" type="Bool">
+      <default>true</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="title" type="String">
       <default></default>
     </entry>
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Left panel: the popup lists every launcher with its full name, as a wide menu
With "Show launcher names in popup" off: a compact row of icons; hovering shows the name in a tooltip
Settings before: no option for the popup's appearance
Settings after: new "Show launcher names in popup" checkbox, enabled only when the popup is
Bottom panel with the option off: icons in a row above the arrow
